svg.text: Archive reads at the last block of each month, on two RPCs that gave identical answers. Stablecoins and BUIDL at $1, sDAI and sUSDS at their vaults'
conversion rates, the Curve position at the fund's share of the pool's USDC and USDtb, Uniswap positions at their tokens and uncollected fees,
ETH at Chainlink's ETH/USD price, USTB at a price interpolated between the fund's purchase and redemption prices.
The fund is the Safe 0x2b5ab59163a6e93b4486f6055d33ca4a115dd4d5. At Ethereum block 26,178,998 on October 12, 2026 it was worth 62.10 million dollars.
